elements.name: DummySlicer
elements.description: Fictional doc-slicer used only as a graphcode test rig — NOT graphify. Turns an unstructured document set into a recall-first candidate graph with provenance.

elements.name: Structure an unstructured document set
elements.description: Actor feeds a document set; the system returns a candidate graph from which a typed model can be built. Realizes the slicing goal.

elements.name: Slice into untyped candidate graph
elements.description: Recall-first slicer: given a DocSet, surface the superset of plausible candidate nodes (untyped) with a sourceRef on each. Deterministic. NOT yet realized (no codeRef) — this is the milestone to implement.

elements.name: Recall-first surfacing
elements.description: Surface the superset of plausible candidates; core recall >= 0.85 on a real document; never silently drop a candidate. Precision is a later concern.

elements.name: Deterministic extraction
elements.description: Same input yields the same candidate set with stable, deterministic IDs (re-run Jaccard = 1.0). No randomness, no wall-clock in IDs.

elements.name: Provenance via sourceRef
elements.description: Every emitted candidate carries a non-empty sourceRef { doc, page, region } so provenance survives the hand-off to the typer.

elements.name: Recall benchmark
elements.description: Target: slice() over a ground-truth document. Tool: vitest + scoreRecall (see spikes/score.ts). PASS iff core recall >= 0.85.

elements.name: Re-run determinism check
elements.description: Target: slice() run twice on the same input. Tool: vitest. PASS iff the candidate sets are identical and IDs stable (Jaccard = 1.0).

elements.name: sourceRef presence assertion
elements.description: Target: every candidate in the SlicerOutput. Tool: vitest. PASS iff each carries a non-empty sourceRef { doc, page, region }.

elements.name: DocSet
elements.description: Input flow: a primary document plus attachments, as { id, text, page } records.

elements.name: SlicerOutput
elements.description: Output shape: { candidates: Array<{ id: string; text: string; sourceRef: { doc: string; page: number; region: string } }> }. id is a deterministic hash of (doc,page,region,text).

elements.name: slicer
elements.description: Host module for the slice function (src/slice.ts).

elements.name: Milestone: Slicer core
elements.description: First milestone — implement FN-slice so the recall/determinism/provenance tests pass.
